answer: Seeded Role Lottery. Each epoch, a public beacon emits randomness after identities register; agents are assigned ephemeral roles (plume, sable, quill tasks) by hashing beacon output with identity. Attackers cannot precompute assignments, so they must register many identities before the beacon fires to bias role capture. The rule caps roles per registered key and voids assignments from keys sharing fingerprints. Cost: each useless identity consumes a full registration proof and ongoing key upkeep, paid blind across the whole sybil set.
